correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact moments from disk orthogonality, applying it to f and f². The only phase interaction is |b²+2ac|², so when all coefficients are nonzero the stated congruence is necessary. For nonzero a, fixing s=|c/a| and parametrizing by the linear-mode fraction of L² energy makes the phase-aligned ratio a quadratic with positive slope at fraction 0 and negative slope at 1. Its sole maximum reproduces the stated rational envelope; its derivative changes sign exactly once by the factored cubic and Descartes' rule. Substitution at the root gives |b/a|²=s+3. Independently reoptimized every two-mode face, yielding 8/5, 11/6 and 99/43. These are strictly below the interior envelope maximum. The resultant gives the claimed polynomial for K; its derivative has strictly positive coefficients after shifting K by 5/2, and the envelope at s=3 is already greater than 5/2, so the value is the largest real root. This proves the sharp constant and all equality cases rather than inferring them from samples.
